Full-time Fire Engineering Technologist position available with a competitive salary package. Join AFLASH FIRE PTY LTD, a professional fire protection company based in Strathfield South NSW 2136, specialising in fire testing, maintenance, certification, and new fire protection installations, with plans to expand its fire engineering design and advisory services.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
• Full-Time Fire Engineering Technologist
• $80,000 to $100,000 p.a. plus superannuation
• Opportunity to support the expansion of AFLASH FIRE PTY LTD’s fire engineering services

AFLASH FIRE PTY LTD is a professional fire protection company providing comprehensive fire safety services, including fire testing, maintenance, certification, and new fire protection installations. As part of our continued growth and expansion, we are seeking an experienced Fire Engineering Technologist to establish and develop our fire engineering design and advisory capabilities.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the expansion of our service offering by providing fire engineering expertise, developing technical solutions, and assisting with the delivery of fire safety strategies and engineering designs.

This position provides an opportunity to contribute to the growth of AFLASH FIRE PTY LTD’s fire engineering services while working alongside an established fire protection business committed to safety, compliance, and quality outcomes.
We are currently seeking an experienced Fire Engineering Technologist to join our team on a full-time basis in Strathfield South NSW 2136.

Current Opening:

This opportunity is a full-time Fire Engineering Technologist position 

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

• Making Engineering designs & calculations, sketches and/or diagrams to help prevent fire or fire spread (‘fire strategy’) for the design of Fire Sprinkler Systems, Fire Hydrant and Hose Reel Systems, Fire Detection and Alarm Systems etc.
• Identifying possible fire-related risks and reducing or eliminating them & implementation of designed systems.
• Incorporating fire safety procedures into designs – such as sprinkler systems, emergency exits and fire alarms – to minimise the risk of injury and loss of life in the event of a fire, taking into account both the structural integrity of the building and human behaviour.
• Making recommendations for the materials used in the construction or refurbishment of a building.
• Keeping up to date with regulations and legislation.
• Using modelling software for design and development.
• Visiting project/construction sites to advise on the installation or implementation of the designs.
• Providing advice that feeds into decisions on safe building occupancy levels, fire evacuation plans and so on.
• Writing reports on fire strategy.
• Liaising with local authorities and/or building control professionals if and as required.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Relevant Degree 
• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.
• Excellent mathematical skills with the ability to perform engineering calculations and technical analysis.
• High intellect with strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong oral and written communication skills, along with excellent reading comprehension.
• Thorough and comprehensive knowledge of physics and other sciences relevant to engineering and fire safety principles.
• Strong troubleshooting and critical thinking skills.
• Knowledge and understanding of fire safety systems, engineering design principles, regulations, and legislation.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate technical documentation and reports.
• Commitment to maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and compliance.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package of $80,000 to $100,000 p.a. plus superannuation, depending on the successful candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and technical expertise.

The successful applicant will be required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week, 

Location: Strathfield South NSW 2136

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced ACCEPTANCE ENGINEER. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, and NSW.

Role Overview
The Acceptance Engineer works under the direction of the Acceptance Lead to support the successful acceptance, handover, and integration of new and upgraded network assets into Telstra’s operational environment. The role is responsible for ensuring all documentation, as-built records, and asset data are accurate, compliant, and correctly uploaded into Telstra’s DBoR systems in accordance with program and governance requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITY

ACCEPTANCE & HANDOVER
Support the Acceptance Lead in managing the end-to-end acceptance process for Telstra network assets.
Review and validate construction completion packs, ensuring readiness for acceptance and operational handover.

DOCUMENTATION & AS-BUILTS
Ensure all project documentation, including as-built drawings, design updates, and asset data, is accurate, complete, and compliant.
Upload and validate as-built information within Telstra’s DBoR systems upon project completion.
Maintain document version control and ensure alignment between physical assets and system records.

DBoR SYSTEM MANAGEMENT
Create, update, and validate asset records using Telstra’s legacy and current DBoR platforms, including: IDEAL, CANRAD, Structure Builder, MITS, RODS, RFNSA, CADlink, Multiman, CRAMER, TPD, WHISPER, TCSS, NETMAPS, WidePlan, Widefeas, CMART, and TRAC.
Resolve data discrepancies and support data quality audits as required by the program.

STAKEHOLDER COORDINATION
Work closely with the Acceptance Lead, internal Telstra teams, delivery partners, and external contractors to coordinate acceptance activities.
Support issue resolution relating to site access, design compliance, documentation gaps, and system data conflicts.
Act as a key interface between construction, design, and operational teams during acceptance and handover.

COMPLIANCE & GOVERNANCE
Ensure all works comply with Telstra design guidelines, relevant Australian Standards, and WHS/safety requirements.
Support program governance by ensuring acceptance processes align with Telstra policies and audit requirements.
Assist with continuous improvement initiatives across acceptance and handover processes.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS
